ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit recovery-wipe combo: vssadmin + bcdedit + wbadmin chained from one host
ucs.description: Hunts the signature LockBit (BITWISE SPIDER / Storm-0506) pre-encryption sequence where a single host issues at least two of vssadmin shadowcopy delete, bcdedit recovery disable, wmic shadowcopy delete, or wbadmin delete catalog within minutes. This combo precedes T1486 file encryption in essentially every LockBit 2.0 / 3.0 (Black) / Green / 5.0 affiliate playbook and was called out in the joint CISA/FBI #StopRansomware:LockBit advisory.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","wmic.exe") AND (Processes.process="*delete *shadow*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime dc(process_name) as binary_variety values(process_name) as binaries values(commands) as command_list by dest user parent_process_name
| where binary_variety >= 2 AND user!="*$"
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let RecoveryWipe = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
              ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessId;
RecoveryWipe
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            BinaryVariety = dcount(FileName),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName, 8),
            Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 16),
            Parent = any(InitiatingProcessFileName)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where BinaryVariety >= 2     // LockBit chains at least two recovery-wipe utilities
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| extend ImageLower = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = CommandLine
| where (ImageLower endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and Cmd has_all ("delete","shadows"))
     or (ImageLower endswith "\\wmic.exe" and Cmd has "shadowcopy" and Cmd has "delete")
     or (ImageLower endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and (Cmd has "recoveryenabled" or Cmd has "bootstatuspolicy"))
     or (ImageLower endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and Cmd has_all ("delete","catalog"))
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            BinaryVariety = dcount(ImageLower),
            Binaries = make_set(ImageLower, 8),
            Commands = make_set(Cmd, 16),
            Parent = any(ParentProcessName)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where BinaryVariety >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ( (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *bootstatuspolicy*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"delete catalog"*) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*delete*) ) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i CommandLine=/shadowcopy.*delete/i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(as=evt_count), count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=binary_variety), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine], multival=true)])
| binary_variety >= 2
ucs.rationale: LockBit affiliates ship a built-in chained recovery-wipe routine in the encryptor itself (vssadmin + bcdedit + wbadmin called from the same parent), unlike one-off ransomware that typically calls only vssadmin. ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit 2.0+ Active Directory self-propagation via SYSVOL payload drop and gpupdate burst
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit 2.0's signature auto-spread feature where the encryptor authenticates to the DC, drops itself (or a loader) into the domain SYSVOL share, then forces gpupdate /force from the same host to push a malicious GPO domain-wide. This AD-aware self-propagation was introduced in LockBit 2.0 ('LockBit Red') and is essentially unique to this family — Microsoft and Mandiant both attribute it to BITWISE SPIDER and tracked it under DEV-0671 / Pistachio Tempest before consolidating it as Storm-0506.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as dropTime max(_time) as lastDrop values(Filesystem.file_path) as drop_paths values(Filesystem.file_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\sysvol\\*") (Filesystem.file_name="*.exe" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ps1" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.bat" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.vbs") Filesystem.user!="*$" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as gpTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="gpupdate.exe" Processes.process="*/force*" by Processes.dest
    | rename Processes.dest as dest
  ]
| where gpTime >= dropTime AND gpTime <= dropTime + 600
| eval delay_sec = gpTime - dropTime
| `security_content_ctime(dropTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(gpTime)`
| table dropTime gpTime delay_sec dest user process_name drop_paths sha256
ucs.kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let SysvolDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\sysvol\\"
    | where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll"
         or FileName endswith ".ps1" or FileName endswith ".bat"
         or FileName endswith ".vbs"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("gpmc.exe","mmc.exe","wbengine.exe","gpotool.exe","adsync.exe")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DropUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              DropProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              PayloadFile = FileName, PayloadPath = FolderPath, SHA256;
let GpForce = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "gpupdate.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "/force"
    | project GpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, GpUser = AccountName, GpCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
SysvolDrops
| join kind=inner GpForce on DeviceId
| where GpTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', GpTime, DropTime)
| project DropTime, GpTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, DropUser, DropProcess,
          DropCmd, PayloadFile, PayloadPath, SHA256, GpUser, GpCmd
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let SysvolDrops = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where TargetFilePath matches regex @"(?i)\\sysvol\\"
    | where TargetFileExtension in~ ("exe","dll","ps1","bat","vbs")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where ActingProcessName !has_any ("gpmc.exe","mmc.exe","wbengine.exe")
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, Host = DvcHostname,
              DropUser = ActorUsername,
              DropProcess = ActingProcessName,
              DropCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine,
              PayloadFile = TargetFileName, PayloadPath = TargetFilePath,
              PayloadSHA256 = TargetFileSHA256;
let GpForce = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688 and NewProcessName endswith "gpupdate.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "/force"
    | project GpTime = TimeGenerated, Host = Computer, GpUser = SubjectUserName, GpCmd = CommandLine;
SysvolDrops
| join kind=inner GpForce on Host
| where GpTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', GpTime, DropTime)
| project DropTime, GpTime, DelaySec, Host, DropUser, DropProcess,
          DropCmd, PayloadFile, PayloadPath, PayloadSHA256, GpUser, GpCmd
| order by DropTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit 2.0+ Self-Propagation Payload Drop in Domain SYSVOL
id: 0c4d5e6f-7a8b-4c9d-9e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f
status: experimental
description: Detects a non-machine-account process writing an executable or script payload to the domain SYSVOL share, a signature LockBit 2.0+ Active Directory self-spread step that precedes a gpupdate /force burst.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2022/05/09/ransomware-as-a-service-understanding-the-cybercrime-gig-economy-and-how-to-protect-yourself/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.lateral_movement
  - attack.t1570
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1484.001
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\SYSVOL\'
      - '\sysvol\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.exe'
      - '.dll'
      - '.ps1'
      - '.bat'
      - '.vbs'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  filter_admintools:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\gpmc.exe'
      - '\mmc.exe'
      - '\wbengine.exe'
      - '\gpotool.exe'
  condition: selection_path and not filter_machine and not filter_admintools
falsepositives:
  - GPO authoring from administrative workstations using GPMC
  - SCCM / Intune GPO migration tooling running under a service account
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\SYSVOL\\* OR *\\sysvol\\* OR *\\Sysvol\\*) @TargetFilename:(*.exe OR *.EXE OR *.dll OR *.DLL OR *.ps1 OR *.PS1 OR *.bat OR *.BAT OR *.vbs OR *.VBS) -@User:*$ -@Image:(*\\gpmc.exe OR *\\mmc.exe OR *\\wbengine.exe OR *\\GPMC.exe OR *\\MMC.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\sysvol\\.+\.(exe|dll|ps1|bat|vbs)$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(gpmc|mmc|wbengine|gpotool)\.exe$/i
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
    | ImageFileName=/\\gpupdate\.exe$/i
    | CommandLine=/\/force/i
    | gpTime := _time
    | groupBy([aid], function=[min(gpTime, as=gpTime)])
  }, field=aid, include=[gpTime])
| gpTime >= _time AND gpTime <= _time + 600
| delay_sec := (gpTime - _time)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=[count(as=drops), min(delay_sec, as=min_delay_sec), collect([CommandLine])])
